context: PATH: a narrow winding path creates a leading line from the lower foreground toward a house or focal object. Use position bottom, layer midground, bend left/center/right, and moderate width_scale (about 0.8–1.0). Place it after meadow and before the house so it appears to arrive at the door instead of covering the building. Use a muted tan primary color and a pale secondary highlight.
